description:
§29.1 — the cumulative-disclosure guard's tracking-state contract.

Fingerprints (hashed identifiers) accumulate across egresses within
a mint window; the arm checks whether a new egress combined with
prior egresses crosses the reconstruction-threshold.

arm_admitted.description: Whether the cumulative arm is opened. False at G6 v0 by spec-anchored closed-seam pattern (§29.1 'Until V2 passes'; §32 DPO/Owner-owned thresholds).
arm_admitted.title: Arm Admitted

egress_fingerprints.description: SHA-256 hex fingerprints of prior egress artifacts in this window. Empty at G6 v0 — the arm is closed-seam so no egress accumulates via this arm's path.
egress_fingerprints.title: Egress Fingerprints

epsilon_budget.description: Cumulative differential-privacy epsilon budget for the window (§21.2). None at G6 v0.
epsilon_budget.title: Epsilon Budget

k_threshold.description: k parameter for k-anonymity (§21.2). None at G6 v0 — the arm is closed-seam until DPO config lands (§32).
k_threshold.title: K Threshold

l_threshold.description: l parameter for l-diversity (§21.2). None at G6 v0.
l_threshold.title: L Threshold

mint_window_id.description: uuid of the mint window; when the window closes, the key is purged (§21.2) and this ledger row is retained but no longer combinable with future windows.
mint_window_id.title: Mint Window Id

title: CumulativeDisclosureLedger
